welcome.title: Welcome to D-Klothes
welcome.lead: A private app, between friends, to sort out your wardrobe: you photograph a piece of clothing, your friends tell you whether it suits you, whether it no longer does, or whether they want it.
welcome.cta: Sign in or create an account
welcome.shareText: Let’s sort out our wardrobes together with D-Klothes!

photo.title: Take a photo
photo.body: Add a photo of a piece of clothing to your group. Location, device and date are removed before upload.

friends.title: Your group gives advice
friends.body: Each member swipes through the photos: Keep, Let go or I want this. One vote per person, changeable.

decide.title: You decide
decide.body: You see the totals and who wants your item. Nothing is thrown away or given away for you.

welcome.installTitle: Install the app on your phone
welcome.installLead: No app store: D-Klothes installs from the browser in three taps.

ios.title: iPhone / iPad (Safari)
ios.step2: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow).

android.title: Android (Chrome)
android.step2: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top right corner.
android.step3: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

desktop.title: Computer (Chrome, Edge)
desktop.step1: Open this site in Chrome or Edge.
desktop.step2: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar.
desktop.step3: Confirm: the app opens in its own window.

welcome.installHint: It also works without installing, right in the browser.
welcome.privacy1: Your photos are seen only by the members of your group, by invitation.
welcome.privacy2: Nobody sees who said Keep or Let go. Only you see who wants your item.
welcome.privacy3: No ads, no tracking, no data resale.
welcome.privacy4: Photos are deleted after two years, or sooner if you decide. You can export or delete your account at any time.
welcome.inviteOnly: Access is by invitation: ask the person who told you about it for a link.
welcome.source: Free software, source code on GitHub
